notes: The potentiometer's three legs are placed in breadboard columns 10, 11 and 12 (bottom half, row e), as read from the circuit image.

In the image the yellow wire's end sits in the top half of the board above the pot's center pin. Top-half and bottom-half strips are not connected, so I put it on the center pin's strip (11b.d). This matches the manual text: center pin to A0.

Black wire goes to the second GND header pin on the Uno (GND.2). It connects to the pot leg in column 10, and the red wire (5V) connects to the leg in column 12. The pot is symmetric between its outer legs, so the choice does not matter electrically.
The Arduino is not powered via a drawn USB cable in the images, so no USB cable is included, though the sketch prints to the computer's serial monitor.
